stem: What is the most accessible link text in documentation?

options.rationale: It makes no sense out of context.
It does not say what will be read.
A raw URL is hard to understand and to read aloud.

options.text: Text that describes the destination or purpose
options.rationale: Descriptive link text stays meaningful in a list of links.

explanation: Link text should describe the destination or purpose, so it makes sense when read out of context in a list of links.
